head: 2d0631412e835e23a3f4c9460d1b2f4b48c128a9
status: Focused P06 producer-frontier evidence. No source changes or acceptance claim.

confirmed_records_and_forwarders.trace: placements computes world_x/world_z, retains both f32 fields, instanced_understory destructures them before terrain query.
confirmed_records_and_forwarders.action: Admit one ScenePlanPoint after the complete deterministic grid/jitter coordinate calculation and retain it through the placement record and renderer; preserve RNG and iteration order.

confirmed_records_and_forwarders.trace: world_x/world_z parameters are recombined into Vec2 only to query terrain and build Transform. litter::forest_floor_patch_transform separately forwards its computed point as two raw coordinates.
confirmed_records_and_forwarders.action: Carry the canonical ScenePlanPoint through the helper signature; admit at the completed litter jitter kernel rather than inside the next query consumer. Native Transform packing uses final metres.

confirmed_records_and_forwarders.trace: cell_allows_grass computes render_centre:Vec2, forwards it through grass_patch_placement_with_spacing, then splits it into raw x/z for grass_patch_transform.
confirmed_records_and_forwarders.action: Retain ScenePlanPoint across the application placement helpers; project for the actual cover/native geometry or Transform operation, not before a forwarder that admits the same point again.

confirmed_records_and_forwarders.trace: The complete placement kernel derives the root from sampled support and retains it for production Transform and capture framing.
confirmed_records_and_forwarders.action: Trace and reuse Position<Scene> where the root crosses retained application records; projection at the actual native Transform or camera math is valid. Do not mistake the final computed 3D root for the original support-elevation scalar.

confirmed_records_and_forwarders.trace: The trait height(centre:Vec2)->Option<f32> is implemented by ScenePlacement and VistaTuftPlacement. Both owned-support paths project SurfaceHit.elevation.metres() before the trait result crosses into scatter_cell_tufts.
confirmed_records_and_forwarders.action: Carry ScenePlanPoint and SupportElevation through the shared trait and both implementations; admit centre once after the complete deterministic lattice/jitter calculation, and project height only at InstanceData Vec3 packing. Keep coverage/community point forwarding typed too; native mask/hash kernels remain explicit endpoints.

confirmed_records_and_forwarders.trace: Owned branch flattens SupportElevation; sampled branch computes the native finite-difference normal and slope gate before returning the sampled float.
confirmed_records_and_forwarders.action: Retain the admitted elevation through the trait. Admit the sampled branch only after its whole native height/slope calculation. Preserve the exact owned/source distinction, centre-relative origin, central differences, missing-neighbor centre-height fallback and slope threshold.

confirmed_records_and_forwarders.trace: Owned branch returns a raw projection of SurfaceHit.elevation; sampled branch forwards the native presented-height query. This method is absent from the height_at-name inventory.
confirmed_records_and_forwarders.action: Carry the same SupportElevation result and ScenePlanPoint across the root-height application API, trace all callers through retained tree placement and native endpoints; preserve the sampled-versus-owned authority policy. The separate scenery_surface already retains SurfaceHit.

coverage_limit: The frozen 185-query inventory is not a complete file or API list. The shared TuftPlacement trait and tree_root_height paths also erase checked support without a height_at call. Trace their downstream retainers and native endpoints before P06 edits. No P06 implementation or acceptance is claimed.
native_boundaries: Keep scratch grid indices, noise/jitter arithmetic, native vectors inside complete geometry kernels and final GPU/Transform packing native. A private helper name alone is not boundary evidence.
